decks.notes: Utilize self-cycling creatures and cascade abilities to consistently put creatures into the graveyard, then cast Living End to bring them all back into play for a powerful board presence. Use cards like Violent Outburst to trigger cascade and end the game with a surge of creatures. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a massive graveyard recursion engine, taking advantage of powerful creatures like Endurance and Oliphaunt to dominate the battlefield. Additionally, cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation provide disruption and protection to ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

This deck focuses on using a variety of creatures to quickly assemble powerful combos. By using cards like Devoted Druid, Vizier of Remedies, and Walking Ballista, the deck can generate infinite mana and deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes toolbox creatures like Duskwatch Recruiter and Fiend Artisan to search for specific answers or threats. Leyline of Abundance and Green Sun's Zenith provide additional consistency and flexibility in assembling the combo pieces. The inclusion of Craterhoof Behemoth and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu allows for explosive finishing plays.

The main theme of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counter spells, and removal. By playing cards like Thoughtseize, Counterspell, and Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from executing their strategy effectively. Additionally, the inclusion of creatures like Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional ways to control the battlefield and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and strategic play.

The deck focuses on generating mana and ramping up to powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Ugin's Labyrinth. It also includes cards like Fight Rigging and Disciple of Freyalise to generate additional value and maintain board presence. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with high-cost creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, ultimately dominating the game through sheer power and control.

This deck focuses on using Allosaurus Rider, Eldritch Evolution, and Neoform to quickly ramp into powerful creatures like Ghalta, Griselbrand, and Atraxa. It includes support cards like Summoner's Pact and Pact of Negation to protect the combo. The deck also includes cards like Veil of Summer and Nature's Claim to protect against disruption. The goal is to create a fast, efficient combo that overwhelms the opponent with big threats early in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan using a combination of land destruction, removal spells, and board wipes. By consistently destroying the opponent's lands with cards like Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin, as well as removing threats with Path to Exile and Galvanic Discharge, the player aims to create a situation where they have the upper hand in the game. The addition of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy with the deck's strategy.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is focused on disruption and card advantage. The deck includes a variety of counterspells and discard spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it includes removal like Fatal Push to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes card draw and filtering through cards like Preordain and Cling to Dust, along with creatures like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy and out-valuing them through card advantage.

This deck aims to quickly generate mana and cast spells that deal damage to the opponent, utilizing cards like Pyretic Ritual and Ral, Monsoon Mage to create explosive turns. By chaining together cheap spells and utilizing Past in Flames to recast them from the graveyard, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a flurry of burn spells and finish them off with Grapeshot. The key strategy is to efficiently ramp up mana production, draw through the deck, and assemble the combo pieces needed to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using various reanimator spells and creatures to quickly bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, allowing for explosive combos and overwhelming board presence. Utilizing a mix of control elements and card draw, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while assembling the necessary pieces to successfully reanimate key creatures such as Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones. With access to powerful removal spells and bounce effects, the deck can easily navigate through threats and establish a dominant position on the battlefield.

This deck revolves around leveraging the power of creatures like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to accumulate +1/+1 counters with Blade of the Bloodchief, while using Ancient Stirrings to find necessary combo pieces and protection. Urza's Saga helps tutor for essential cards, and Eldrazi Temple accelerates mana for big plays like Emrakul, the Promised End. Sowing Mycospawn provides additional token generation for further synergy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures and spells, controlling the board and ultimately securing victory through sheer force and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back into play for explosive combos. The deck also utilizes instant spells like Solitude and Force of Negation for protection and disruption, while cards like Thoughtseize help to control the opponent's hand. Overall, the deck aims to reanimate big threats out of nowhere, overwhelming the opponent and securing a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Broodscale creatures and Bloodchief blade to create a powerful combo that overwhelms opponents. By using cards like Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces and Kozilek's Command to control the board, the deck aims to create a dominant board presence. The inclusion of Emrakul, the Promised End adds a strong finisher to the deck, while cards like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple provide mana acceleration to get the combo pieces out quickly. Overall, the deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay and combo synergy.

This deck focuses on accelerating mana production with ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. Control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble help deal with opposing threats, while cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Herigast, Erupting Nullkite provide additional disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures and powerful spells, while maintaining control over the board with its versatile suite of removal and protection spells.

This deck focuses on using cards that can exile and return creatures from the battlefield, allowing for repeated triggers and additional attacks. The strategy involves aggressive plays while also utilizing blinking effects to disrupt the opponent's board state and gain value through creature abilities. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, while also incorporating hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. Overall, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggro creatures and blink effects to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource for powering up Cosmogoyf and other creatures, while also running a combo with Thud and Devourer of Destiny for a potential fast kill. The deck includes cards like Serum Powder and Chancellor of the Dross to manipulate the starting hand, as well as cards like Spoils of the Vault and Plunge into Darkness for digging through the deck quickly. The goal is to set up a strong board presence and combo finish before the opponent can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of spells and creatures that disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up its own board presence. It utilizes a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and creatures with disruptive abilities to slow down the opponent and gain advantage. The deck also includes various lands to help fix mana and ensure consistency in casting its spells. It aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition by taking control of the game and setting the tempo in its favor.
